arts.ttl: Assan Ouédraogo guides RB Leipzig to victory against Werder Bremen
arts.sum: Leipzig dominated the opening exchanges, with Ridle Baku and Ouédraogo forcing early saves from Bremen goalkeeper Mio Backhaus . As half-time approached, Baumgartner's deflected shot looked destined for goal until Backhaus produced a spectacular fingertip save to ensure the teams went in level.
